description: Plan one alternative-text repair for a missing-alt image on an existing Canvas Page. Requires fresh audit evidence for the current Page body and image source. Preserves the Page body and settings except for one selected image alt attribute. No Canvas write occurs during planning. Does not support block-editor pages or prove accessibility conformance.
executor_wiring: wired: catalog/a11y/runner.py plan mode (run_planner). Validates the repair plan against a fresh read, produces the plan artifact, and refuses dispatch. dispatch/executor.py carries no a11y branches per the F-17 carve.

honesty.interpretation: This planner changes one image alt attribute only. It does not prove accessibility conformance.

multi_step.name: fresh_read_target
multi_step.note: Fresh-read the exact target (course, quiz/bank, and question/item as the kind requires). The read must return the complete saved body; an incomplete read refuses the plan.

multi_step.name: validate_repair_plan
multi_step.note: Validate the plan against the fresh audit evidence. Refusals: stale_body: the target changed since the signal; run the audit again; image_position_shifted: the image is no longer at this index; image_source_mismatch: the image at this index is not the signaled image; ambiguous_image: the same image is used more than once; decorative_needs_empty_alt / alt_text_required: alt_text/decorative inconsistency; protected_quiz: New Quiz 506477 is never touched. Planner-specific guards: Non-block-editor Pages only; block-editor pages are refused. Changes one escaped alt attribute; keeps the other Page bytes and settings. The plan and journal use only digests and offsets, not the Page body, image tag, or image URL.

multi_step.name: require_authorization
multi_step.note: Requires human approval or a selected valid Edit authority. No Canvas write occurs during planning.

multi_step.name: guarded_single_dispatch
multi_step.note: One dispatch of the reviewed single-alt update with exact readback of the saved target.

multi_step.name: re_audit_same_target
multi_step.note: Run morrow_audit_course_item again on the same course and target. Report which observed fields, digests, and source signals changed. Stop on stale, incomplete, held, or unverified evidence; do not retry a write automatically.

name: morrow_plan_page_image_alt_repair

alt_text.description: Alternative text a person can read, or empty when marking decorative.

decorative.description: True marks the image decorative with empty alternative text.

expected_body_sha256.description: Digest of the exact saved body this repair was planned against.

image_index.description: Position of the image in the saved field, counting every image from 1.

image_src_sha256.description: Digest of the selected image's src attribute from the fresh audit.

planner_notes: Non-block-editor Pages only; block-editor pages are refused.
Changes one escaped alt attribute; keeps the other Page bytes and settings.
The plan and journal use only digests and offsets, not the Page body, image tag, or image URL.
title: Review a Canvas Page image alternative-text repair
